answer: Planted-contradiction canaries expose sybil reviewers: 5% of review seats hide an arithmetic error, like totals off by one inside a shale-flat, tidy report. A clone swarm sharing one template waves it through like a dune of identical praise, a ferrous rubber stamp; 1,000 fakes fail about 50 canaries and lose their grading stake. An honest reader pays only careful reading. It fails if canaries leak, so rotate them.
